scenarios.name: profile-retries
scenarios.behavior: After two failed profile reads in a row, the page retries on its own and shows the profile.
scenarios.expectation: Requirement PRF-3: a failed profile read is retried up to three times before an error is shown.
scenarios.limits: Only HTTP 503 failures of the profile read on the profile page.

scenarios.name: items-keep-content
scenarios.behavior: When a refresh of a loaded item list fails, the items stay on screen.
scenarios.expectation: Requirement ITM-7: a failed refresh keeps the last items and shows an error.
scenarios.limits: One HTTP 503 refresh failure on the item list; not offline mode or first loads.

scenarios.name: jobs-status
scenarios.behavior: After a successful status read, the export job's row shows its current state.
scenarios.expectation: Requirement JOB-2: a job row shows the state of the last successful status read.
scenarios.limits: The export job's state text only; not the row's other fields or other jobs.

scenarios.name: inbox-empty-state
scenarios.behavior: An inbox with no messages shows its empty state, also after a failed read is retried.
scenarios.expectation: Requirement INB-1: an empty inbox shows "No messages"; it is not an error.
scenarios.limits: Only the empty inbox; an inbox with messages is not checked.

scenarios.name: sync-partial-failure
scenarios.question: When a sync fails halfway through, should the list keep the items that already synced, or roll back to the list from before the sync?
